name: M8.PhysicalBridge.pointwise_optimizer
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M8.PhysicalBridge.Recipe N) (g : M7.Action.Record N), ∀ w : ℕ, M8.PhysicalBridge.Valid w c → M8.PhysicalBridge.Anchored (M7.Action.act g c) → M6.Final.PointwiseCorrect N (M7.Supports.polynomial (M7.Action.act g c).1) (M7.Supports.polynomial (M7.Action.act g c).2)
guidance:
Original accepted M8 sections 4–6 physical correctness only. Raw c is not necessarily anchored; actual act g c is anchored as supplied by discovery. Do not assume a correctness oracle or change definitions. Pointwise: use Action.support_cards, Connectivity.connected_action and ClosedSolve.closed_pointwise. Signature uses full RecipeSignature.action_signature_degree. noLogical: sealed PointwiseCorrect AnswerCorrect.1, ActualCounts.f and Domain/RecipeSignature definitions identify degree; monic signature degree zero iff signature=1 via Polynomial.Monic.natDegree_eq_zero. For witness obtain actual some from noLogical and Option cases. Apply Transport.actual_witness to transformed recipe and inverse g, with Connectivity.anchored_gcd; simplify Action.act_inverse. Obtain lower bound from Pinned.solve_exact with PointwiseCorrect.CountingCorrect or ActualResult.solve_exact, then transport any original LX with Transport.x_logical and action_isometry weight. Alternatively common_quantum_distance plus Pinned.distance_spec gives the lower bound directly on original c. Original LX is cycleWords minus boundaryWords; Domain.coefficients_indicator makes actual M6 definitions agree. No root/log-span/family assumptions: those are downstream restrictions of these general physical interfaces. Return tactic lines only.
import M7ClosedSolveAccepted
import M7RecipeSignatureAccepted
namespace M8.PhysicalBridge
abbrev Recipe (N : ℕ) := M7.Action.Recipe N
noncomputable def signature {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (c : Recipe N) := M7.RecipeSignature.signature c
noncomputable def solve {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (c : Recipe N) :=
  M6.ActualTransfer.solve N (M7.Supports.polynomial c.1) (M7.Supports.polynomial c.2)
def Valid {N : ℕ} (w : ℕ) (c : Recipe N) : Prop :=
  c.1.card = w ∧ c.2.card = w ∧ M7.Connectivity.connected c
def Anchored {N : ℕ} (c : Recipe N) : Prop := (0 : ZMod N) ∈ c.1 ∧ (0 : ZMod N) ∈ c.2
noncomputable def undo {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (g : M7.Action.Record N) := M7.Transport.Xmap (M7.Action.inverse g)
end M8.PhysicalBridge
